title: SurrealDB Official Library Integration - Implementation Trace
description: Complete trace of current buggy implementation and desired state for replacing custom HTTP client with official surrealdb-py library to fix variant_id persistence bug

specification.name: SurrealDB Official Library Integration
specification.problem: variant_id and activity_id fields becoming NONE in template_metrics, breaking Thompson Sampling
specification.rootCause: Custom HTTP RPC client has parameter serialization bugs + using update() instead of merge()
specification.solution: Replace with official surrealdb-py (>=1.0.0), upgrade to SurrealDB v3.0+, use merge() for partial updates

criticalBugs.issue: db.update() replaces ALL fields - must explicitly include variant_id/activity_id or they become NONE
criticalBugs.fix: Replace db.update() with db.merge() for partial updates

criticalBugs.issue: Manual JSON serialization in _execute_rpc() has parameter binding bugs
criticalBugs.evidence: Lines 153-155 log variant_id for debugging NONE values
criticalBugs.fix: Replace entire custom client with official surrealdb-py library

criticalBugs.issue: Same update() vs merge() issue when updating from endpoint
criticalBugs.evidence: No explicit variant_id preservation in update_data

steps.currentBehavior: Receives metrics, calls get_metrics() then db.update()
steps.desiredBehavior: Same but using official async client with db.merge()

steps.currentBehavior: Uses db.update() with explicit variant_id/activity_id preservation
steps.desiredBehavior: Use db.merge() to preserve immutable fields automatically

steps.currentBehavior: Custom HTTP RPC with manual serialization (buggy)
steps.desiredBehavior: Official library's async update() with proper binding

components.currentBehavior: Custom HTTP RPC, sync operations, manual JSON serialization

implementationPhases.name: Replace custom client with official library
tasks: Implement async methods: connect, query, create, select, update, merge, delete
Update get_surreal_client() to return async client

implementationPhases.name: Fix update operations to use merge()
tasks: Change template_metrics.py:273 from db.update() to db.merge()
Change activity.py:509 from db.update() to db.merge()
Update all operations to be async

implementationPhases.name: Upgrade SurrealDB deployment
tasks: Update k8s deployment manifest to surrealdb:v3.0+
Run unified schema initialization on startup

implementationPhases.name: End-to-end validation
tasks: Verify activity_id not NONE after updates

validationCriteria.fieldPersistence: variant_id and activity_id never NULL after create/update operations
validationCriteria.querySuccess: SELECT * FROM template_metrics WHERE variant_id = $variant_id returns correct records
validationCriteria.mergeCorrectness: merge() updates only specified fields, preserves all others
validationCriteria.asyncPerformance: No blocking in FastAPI event loop, improved throughput

metadata.estimatedEffort: 4-5 hours implementation + 1 hour validation = 1 day total
